thy_essential_multi.name: Essential Multi
thy_essential_multi.key: Per 3 capsules: 100 mcg selenium, 15 mg zinc, 150 mcg iodine, 1,000 IU D3, 500 mcg biotin, 120 mcg vitamin K; no iron
thy_essential_multi.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Essential Multi SS ND476' Rev. 08/25, Supplement Facts panel (Dropbox /NutriDyn/Sales/Practitioner Resource/NutriDyn Marketing Materials/, read 2026-11-03): serving 3 capsules, 30/60 servings; selenium (aspartate) 100 mcg, zinc (citrate) 15 mg, iodine (potassium iodide) 150 mcg, vitamin D3 25 mcg (1,000 IU), B12 (methylcobalamin) 200 mcg, biotin 500 mcg, no iron listed; directions 'Take three capsules once daily with food'. Same amounts as the products DB R716 chart label checks (catalog ND143 10/1/26), which also give vitamin K (as phytonadione, K1) 120 mcg per 3 capsules: on the key line and in the medicine check's blood-thinner note. Sizes R716 90C (30 servings) and R716L 180C, ND144 price list 10/1/26. No verified product-page URL, so the link falls back to catalog search. Photo: img-src/R716.png (344x640) is the central 'interpolated stopgap' (Lanczos 4x from the 86x160 chart thumbnail, listed in soft.json), so it prints soft. Print source to stage instead: the crisp 254x420 NutriDyn web render at scratchpad/hires/_dl/art_switchkit/img/r716.png (90-capsule bottle, current label; checked 2026-11-03), or Dropbox '/NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/R716_Web'.

thy_d3_5000_k2.name: D3 5000 with K2
thy_d3_5000_k2.key: 5,000 IU (125 mcg) vitamin D3, 60 mcg vitamin K2 (MK-7), 15 mcg vitamin K1
thy_d3_5000_k2.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'D3 5000 with K2 SS ND382' Rev. 6/24, Supplement Facts panel (Dropbox Marketing Materials, read 2026-11-03): serving 1 softgel, 60 servings; vitamin D3 125 mcg (5,000 IU), vitamin K1 15 mcg, vitamin K2 as MK-7 (MenaQ7) 60 mcg; directions 'Take one softgel daily with food'; label warnings: 'contains vitamin D at a level that exceeds the adult tolerable upper intake level', use 'should be short-term and include regular monitoring' of vitamin D levels, and vitamin K2 'is not recommended for patients on blood-thinning medications'. Matches the products DB R197 chart label checks (catalog ND143 10/1/26). The shared products.py entry d3_5000_k2 says capsules; the label says softgels, so this sheet uses its own entry. URL as used on the menopause sheet (an earlier NutriDyn visit brief) and products.py SLUGS.

thy_iron_support.name: Iron Support
thy_iron_support.key: 29 mg iron (bisglycinate), 80 mg vitamin C, 350 mcg B12, 1,020 mcg DFE folate, 5 mg B6, 1 mg copper
thy_iron_support.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Iron Support SS ND563' Rev. 12/25, Supplement Facts panel (Dropbox Marketing Materials, read 2026-11-03): serving 1 capsule, 180 servings; iron (as ferrous bisglycinate chelate, Ferrochel) 29 mg, vitamin C 80 mg, thiamin 5 mg, vitamin B6 (P5P) 5 mg, folate 1,020 mcg DFE (BioFolate), B12 (methylcobalamin) 350 mcg, copper (lysinate) 1 mg, L-glycine 100 mg, succinic acid 100 mg; directions 'Take one capsule daily'. thy_ultrabiotic_dms.name: UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain
thy_ultrabiotic_dms.key: 30 billion CFU when made: S. boulardii, L. reuteri, B. lactis, L. plantarum, L. acidophilus, L. gasseri, Bacillus coagulans
thy_ultrabiotic_dms.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain SS ND460' Rev. 7/24, Supplement Facts panel (Dropbox Marketing Materials, read 2026-11-03): serving 1 capsule, 30/60 servings, CFU at time of manufacture: Saccharomyces boulardii (Lynside) 5 billion, Lactobacillus reuteri (LRC) 5 billion, Bifidobacterium lactis UABla-12, Lactobacillus plantarum UALp-05, L. acidophilus UALa-01, L. gasseri UALg-05 and Bacillus coagulans UABc-20 at 4.167 billion each (30 billion total); every strain amount carries the label's dagger note 'At time of manufacture', so the printed key line carries it too, in plain words: 'when made' (the seven names give the strain count; 'at manufacture' is 5 letters longer and pushes this, the longest key block, to a 7th line holding only 'coagulans', which makes every column 8.9 pt taller and the footer overflow); directions 'Take one capsule daily'. B. lactis is Bifidobacterium; Bacillus coagulans is spelled out so the two B. genera cannot be confused. Matches products DB R829 and the shared products.py entry ultrabiotic_dms. URL slug from products.py SLUGS (NutriDyn 60-day protocol doc).

thy_omega_1000.name: Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000
thy_omega_1000.key: 1,000 mg EPA + DHA per softgel (730 mg EPA, 270 mg DHA)
thy_omega_1000.src: NutriDyn sell sheet 'Omega Pure EPA-DHA 1000 SS ND416' Rev. 4/25, Supplement Facts panel (Dropbox Marketing Materials, read 2026-11-03): serving 1 softgel, 120 servings; total omega-3 1.1 g, EPA 730 mg, DHA 270 mg, additional omega-3 100 mg, triglyceride form; directions 'Take one softgel 1-3 times daily with food' (the sheet uses one, with dinner, so dosesub 'same meal as the multi'). Matches products DB R243 and the shared products.py entry omega_1000. URL slug from products.py SLUGS (NutriDyn 60-day protocol doc).
